summary: Comprehensive testing of Business Hub Project integration features completed. All 11 backend tests passed. All UI features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing TEST-ACCEPT projects created from Business Hub orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: Business Hub Project integration features fully tested. Projects from Business Hub (with source_order_id) show read-only Client/Location fields with '(from order)' labels and 'From Business Hub Order' badge. Work Items section has 'Completion %' column. Regular projects still have editable Client dropdown. Search filter handles null values correctly.
